Script.name: Resource Ownership
Script.script:
-- Central ownership for runtime-created handlers and timers. -- This fragment loads before the mapper and GUI so every subsystem can use -- the same replace-before-register behavior. GUI = GUI or {} GUI.ownedTimerIds = GUI.ownedTimerIds or {}
local function resourceError(scope, message) if type(GUI.debugError) == "function" then GUI.debugError("RESOURCE/" .. scope, message) else print("[LuminariGUI resource error] " .. tostring(message)) end end
function GUI.cancelOwnedTimer(name) local timerId = GUI.ownedTimerIds[name] if not timerId then return false end
GUI.ownedTimerIds[name] = nil local ok, result = pcall(killTimer, timerId) if not ok then resourceError("TIMER/CANCEL/" .. tostring(name), result) return false end return result ~= false end
function GUI.setOwnedTimer(name, delay, callback) if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then error("GUI.setOwnedTimer requires a non-empty timer name") end if type(callback) ~= "function" then error("GUI.setOwnedTimer requires a function callback") end
GUI.cancelOwnedTimer(name)
local timerId local completedSynchronously = false local function runOwnedTimer(...) completedSynchronously = true if GUI.ownedTimerIds[name] == timerId then GUI.ownedTimerIds[name] = nil end return callback(...) end
local ok, result = pcall(tempTimer, delay, runOwnedTimer) if not ok or result == nil then resourceError("TIMER/CREATE/" .. name, result) return nil, result end
timerId = result if not completedSynchronously then GUI.ownedTimerIds[name] = timerId end return timerId end
function GUI.cancelAllOwnedTimers() local names = {} for name in pairs(GUI.ownedTimerIds) do names[#names + 1] = name end
local canceled = 0 for _, name in ipairs(names) do if GUI.cancelOwnedTimer(name) then canceled = canceled + 1 end end return canceled end
function GUI.registerOwnedHandler(ownerTable, key, event, handler, scope) if type(ownerTable) ~= "table" then error("GUI.registerOwnedHandler requires an owner table") end
local previousId = ownerTable[key] if previousId then local removed, removeResult = pcall( killAnonymousEventHandler, previousId ) if not removed then resourceError( "HANDLER/REMOVE/" .. tostring(scope or key), removeResult ) end ownerTable[key] = nil end
local ok, handlerId = pcall(registerAnonymousEventHandler, event, handler) if not ok or handlerId == nil then resourceError( "HANDLER/CREATE/" .. tostring(scope or key), handlerId ) return nil, handlerId end
ownerTable[key] = handlerId return handlerId end
function GUI.unregisterOwnedHandlers(ownerTable, keys) if type(ownerTable) ~= "table" then return 0 end
local ownedKeys = {} if type(keys) == "table" then for key in pairs(keys) do ownedKeys[#ownedKeys + 1] = key end else for key in pairs(ownerTable) do ownedKeys[#ownedKeys + 1] = key end end
local removed = 0 for _, key in ipairs(ownedKeys) do local handlerId = ownerTable[key] if handlerId then local ok, result = pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, handlerId) if ok and result ~= false then removed = removed + 1 end ownerTable[key] = nil end end return removed end
